title: The Christmas Baby
overview: When a baby boy shows up on their doorstep days before Christmas with a note written specially for them, Erin and Kelly must learn how to navigate their new relationship and career dynamics while unexpectedly caring for a newborn.

title: The 5-Year Christmas Party
overview: Over five years, Alice and her old theater school rival, Max, reunite each holiday season to work at a Chicago catering company's Christmas parties.  While their undeniable chemistry grows, the timing is never right for romance - until the company's final season pushes them to confront their true feelings.

title: Christmas Waltz
overview: After Avery’s storybook Christmas wedding is canceled unexpectedly, dance instructor Roman helps her rebuild her dreams.
